Shanghai Municipal Police    18/12/16

Sinza    Station.

16th December    1916
Avenue
REPORT ON. A gathering of supposed Revolutionaries at 367/8 Edward
VII on the 15th December 1916.

Made by D.S.Page.    Forwarded by Inspector Rivers.

Sir,
    I respectfully beg to report that at 2.30 p.m. 15th inst:
9 Revolutionary leaders visited the home of General Li Tsung Wo
367/8 Avenue Edward VII.
    They had come they said to settle the matter of the return of
some of the Revolutionaries to their Native places.
    As upon the previous day they expressed their unwillingness to
accept a boat ticket without money.    I told them that if
that was their frame of mind it was useless for them to remain
any longer, and requested them to leave the house, this they did,
after some argument.
    Soon after their departure an ever increasing crowd of supposed
Revolutionaries began to gather outside the front of the house.
    I telephoned to Inspt: Aiers informing him of this, and upon
his arrival accompanied by D.I.Fitzgibbon, the crowd was dispersed
peaceably at about 5.30 p.m. , with the aid of the French Police..

                                        I beg to remain,
                                                Sir.
                                        Your obedient servant.
                                                G.S.Page.
                                                        Det: Sgt:

The Chief Det: Inspector.
                Headquarters.

新闸捕房。

1916年12月16日
爱文义路
关于1916年12月15日在爱文义路367/8号举行的疑似革命党人集会的报告。

由警佐 G.S.Page 撰写。由督察 Rivers 转呈。

先生：
    本人谨此报告，本月15日下午2时30分：
9名革命党首领访问了李宗吾将军位于爱文义路367/8号的寓所。
    他们称，此行是为了解决部分革命党人返回原籍一事。
    鉴于前一日他们曾表示不愿接受没有现金配发的船票。本人告知他们，若持此种态度，继续逗留已无意义，并要求他们离开该寓所；经过一番争论后，他们照办了。
    在他们离去后不久，越来越多的疑似革命党人开始在该寓所门前聚集。
    本人致电艾尔斯督察 (Inspt: Aiers) 通报此事；随后，艾尔斯督察在副督察菲茨吉本 (D.I.Fitzgibbon) 的陪同下抵达现场，并在法国巡捕的协助下，于下午5时30分左右和平驱散了人群。

                                        卑职谨上，
                                                先生。
                                        您顺从的仆人。
                                                G.S.Page.
                                                        侦探警佐

首席侦探督察。
                总部。
